title: Hello, I'm Moiz!
subtitle: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description: Product-focused Full Stack Engineer with {{experienceYears}} years of experience building scalable systems across retail and SaaS — from POS platforms to loyalty systems and customer engagement tools. I work across the stack using React, Vue, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS, delivering reliable, high-quality solutions with a strong focus on real-world usability.

I take ownership of features end-to-end — from understanding business needs and structuring solutions to implementation and deployment — with a focus on maintainable code, system efficiency, and software that creates measurable impact. Core strengths include POS retail systems, payment integrations (MyFatoorah, Moyasar), CRM, wallet integrations (Apple Wallet & Google Wallet), microservices and monorepo patterns, and leading UI/UX engineering.

I've revamped and stabilized unstable applications, supported management teams, and improved products by solving real problems. Recent work includes POS platforms, loyalty systems, and customer engagement tools — contributing to both technical architecture and product direction.
